title: Kallita -- ārammaṇa)
text: 1-4 Sāvatthi || || Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo || || 5 Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo || || 6 Neva samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo || || 7 Samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo ca || || 8-9 Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī || pa || uttamo ca pavaro cā ti || ||
